What I do

Practical help with
the next bit.

You might be catching up, starting something new, or trying to make an almost-working tool work properly.

AI implementation

Choose a useful first application, set up the tools, and connect them to your work. We check the results with the team and agree how data and access should be handled.

For example: helping people find information in your organisation’s documents.

Custom software

I build the tool you need when the existing ones don’t quite fit: an internal app, a booking flow, or a repetitive task taken off someone’s plate.

With AI where it helps, and a clear job to do.

Ongoing support

Fixes, improvements, and help with the questions that arrive once people start using a tool. We agree what support you need and keep adjusting as the work changes.

The handover doesn’t have to be the goodbye.

Already have something that nearly works? We can start there.

How we work

Listen closely.
Try together.
Keep learning.

First, a conversation.

Show me the work, the sticking points, and who’s involved. We choose a first step and agree what a useful result would look like.

Then, something to try.

I build a working version. You and your team try it in context, tell me what’s awkward, and help shape what happens next.

After that, everyday use.

We make the details clear: who looks after it, how to check the results, and where to turn when questions come up.

The person doing the work

Hi, I’m Raphael.

I like getting close to a problem and making something useful.

I work directly with your team, from the first conversation to the fixes after launch. Experience in strategy, team management, and facilitation helps me bring people into that process.

I’m happiest with a clear next step, a working first version, and honest feedback along the way.

Over to you

you’re working on.
